deployments_detail.use: Own site: investing in AI/ML to improve member health + contain costs (no named production system; broad disclosure)
CADA (Centene Authorization Digital Assistant): AI assistant that automates clinical prior-authorization and medical-record review to reduce clinician manual workload.
deployments_detail.value: 67% reduction in clinical work across three pilot markets

deployments_detail.use: Real-time data streaming / infrastructure modernization (shift from batch to real-time stream processing) that feeds Centene's AI and predictive analytics across the enterprise, via a partnership with Confluent. [Confluent (Apache Kafka)]

Enterprise generative-AI software engineering built on Microsoft Copilot Studio and Azure — Centene is staffing a 'Lead Copilot Studio AI Engineer' to design and deploy complex enterprise AI software solutions, indicating adoption of Microsoft's agent/copilot platform for internal software. [Microsoft Copilot Studio / Azure]

Apixio AI platform for healthcare analytics, risk adjustment / HCC coding automation and payment integrity, applied to unstructured clinical data across Centene's member base. Centene acquired Apixio in Dec 2020 to 'digitize the administration of healthcare'; operated it until divesting to New Mountain Capital in 2023. [Apixio (Centene subsidiary 2020-2023)]
HALO predictive model that identifies members at risk of substance use disorders from physician notes, medical charts, familial history and genetic profiles, triggering preventive outreach.
deployments_detail.value: 25% reduction in total medical spend; 27% fewer inpatient admissions; 28% fewer ED visits; ~98% accuracy cited

deployments_detail.use: NEST (Neighborhood, Economic, and Social Traits) machine-learning model using 200+ geo-demographic characteristics and member data to identify at-risk members and social determinants of health for care-manager intervention.
Choose Tomorrow suicide-prevention program using a predictive risk model to identify members at risk of suicide before a crisis, determine best intervention, and monitor treatment progress.

Amber conversational AI virtual assistant (built on Centene's 'Colloquium' NLP platform) that handles member customer-service interactions such as premium payments and pairing members with a primary care provider. [Centene Colloquium / Amber (internal NLP)]
deployments_detail.value: 20% increase in likelihood to be satisfied with provider choice; 40% increase in PCP selection; 18% improvement in binder payment rates

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven fraud, waste and abuse detection and payment integrity: advanced analytics plus AI-enabled tools to flag suspicious billing patterns, abnormal claims activity and emerging medical-cost trends earlier, used as an independent validation layer alongside actuarial forecasting to protect Medicaid margins.
deployments_detail.value: Q1 2026 Medicaid health benefits ratio improved 50 bps YoY to 93.1% (attributed partly to cost management/payment integrity)
